chapter: The big band, Kogun and Japanese color
title: The Local 47 rehearsal hall
summary: Brown asks where the rehearsals were: the union hall on Vine Street.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Well, a couple of things that have come up. First of all, I just want to fill in some details: where was the rehearsal facility that you used, in what part of L.A.? Was it in North Hollywood, or was it in Burbank, or…?
You‟re talking about in Los Angeles.
It was the union hall, okay.
Union. 47, Local 47 union, and they had a rehearsal room. And New York didn‟t have it. And as I said, it was 50 cents; today I think it‟s $5.00.
But was it located downtown, or was it located where you were living?
Vine Street. You know where it is?
Uh, I guess that‟s North Hollywood.
You know where it is, okay. So it hasn‟t changed, it‟s still there, same place.
Yes, same place. It‟s still there.
